python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data/FUN_company_pl_actuals_dataset.csv')

# Filter for Net Revenue and last year (2024)
last_year = 2024
revenue_df = df[(df['FSLine Statement L1'] == 'Net Revenue') & (df['Fiscal Year'] == last_year)]

total_revenue = revenue_df['Amount in USD'].sum()

print(f'Revenue for Fiscal Year {last_year}:')
print(f'\${total_revenue:,.2f} USD')

# Show breakdown by FSLine Statement L2
print('\nBreakdown by revenue type:')
breakdown = revenue_df.groupby('FSLine Statement L2')['Amount in USD'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
for item, amount in breakdown.items():
    print(f'  {item}: \${amount:,.2f}')
"
